description: Local Govt. - Eastern Province  - Summon the Meeting to fill the Post of Chairman - Kinniya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the summoning of a meeting to fill a vacancy for the Chairman position in a local authority (Kinniya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including scheduling a meeting for election purposes, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
